scope: Read-only comparison of current Linux OpenMoji overlay against existing local and Linux Git recovery objects; laboratory computer excluded

task_subtree_recovery.mapping: Runtime path equals archive path; current raw SHA256 must equal runtime_sha256 in the manifest

root_tools_recovery.mapping: Archive directory plus runtime basename; restore bytes to original worktree root, not the archive directory

limits: Snapshot only; does not establish scientific reproducibility, choose the current final model, verify live process occupation, or authorize retirement of the runtime. Later changes require another comparison. Historical receipts remain unchanged.
